context:
Closed 13:27 CDT: you are landing home's Duo fold (#386/#390) yourself, so this is yours to decide when you land it; the coordinator's home lane stopped. The pictures and trade-offs below stay for reference.

Goal: on the folded Duo, you reach the room picker (the Rooms pill) easily. The built screen moved the pill from where mockup RM1a drew it; SPEC.md records the departure. Per the builder, the nav bar draws nothing on the folded Duo once a card scrolls, so a pill there hides on scroll (claim, no shot proves it).

designs.label: A: built, pill at the end of the room strip
B: mockup RM1a, pill in the nav bar

options.gain: One thumb reaches it, next to the room strip, and it stays put when a card scrolls.
options.how: As built in PR 386; SPEC.md keeps the departure note.
options.label: Keep it at the strip end
options.lose: It differs from the mockup you approved.

options.how: The lane moves the pill into the nav bar.
options.label: Move it to the nav bar, as drawn
options.lose: One more reach to the top of the folded screen, and per the builder it hides once a card scrolls.

ref: home PR 386 (duo-fold-1), SPEC.md departure from mockup RM1a; pictures on branch claude/gallant-faraday-1ec752 at 9df6451
title: Where should the Rooms pill sit on the folded Duo screen?
why: The design reviewer's pick: the pill sits by the thumb and stays visible on scroll.
